2607.09403.title: Fictional Worldbuilding: Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration with Hierarchical Context Compression and Iterative Review
2607.09403.paper_summary: Worldbuilding, the construction of coherent fictional worlds, is a foundational task in game design and literary creation. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for automated content generation, but their application to worldbuilding faces three challenges: context explosion that grows linearly with the building process, the tension between creative diversity and content consistency, and the absence of automated quality assurance. This paper presents AutoWorldBuilder, a multi-agent collaborative system that addresses these challenges through five integrated components: a structured concept network with conflict detection; a DAG-based hybrid batch scheduler that groups tasks by semantic locality; a four-layer context compression mechanism achieving approximately 90% token reduction; an iterative review system with specialized Auditor agents that improves proposal pass rates from 42% to over 85%; and a skill-driven agent architecture supporting zero-code extension with differentiated temperature configuration. Two experiments across 20 diverse worldbuilding tasks, using GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek v3.2 as LLM backends, demonstrate a 95.0% success rate. The system generated 56-103 self-consistent concepts per world in 18-31 minutes with zero-conflict delivery. The architectural patterns validated here, including layer-as-budget compression, semantic-locality scheduling, and separation of generation and review, transfer to the broader class of knowledge-intensive, multi-agent LLM applications.
2607.09403.paper_summary_zh: 世界建構，即構建一致的虛構世界，是遊戲設計和文學創作中的基礎任務。大型語言模型（LLMs）為自動內容生成提供了新的可能性，但其在世界建構中的應用面臨三個挑戰：隨著建構過程線性增長的上下文爆炸、創意多樣性與內容一致性之間的緊張關係，以及缺乏自動質量保證。本文介紹了AutoWorldBuilder，一個多代理協作系統，通過五個集成組件來解決這些挑戰：一個具有衝突檢測的結構化概念網絡；一個基於DAG的混合批量調度器，根據語義局部性對任務進行分組；一個四層上下文壓縮機制，實現約90%的標記減少；一個具有專門審計代理的迭代審查系統，將提案通過率從42%提高到超過85%；以及一個支持零代碼擴展的技能驅動代理架構，具有差異化的溫度配置。在20個多樣化的世界建構任務中進行的兩次實驗，使用GPT-OSS 120B和DeepSeek v3.2作為LLM後端，顯示出95.0%的成功率。該系統在18-31分鐘內為每個世界生成56-103個自洽概念，並實現零衝突交付。這裡驗證的架構模式，包括層作為預算壓縮、語義局部性調度以及生成與審查的分離，轉移到更廣泛的知識密集型多代理LLM應用類別中。
